# Danceify - AI Dance Videos

> Danceify - AI Dance Videos is an iPhone and iPad app on the App Store (App Store ID 6760788471). It turns one photo of a person, a baby, a dog or a cat into a 10-second dance video, in any of 17 dance styles, and there are also Premium themed templates. Videos save to your phone and can be shared. It is free to download, with no account, sign-up or email; purchases go through your Apple Account. Videos use coins (◆): one-time coin packs start at $3.99 (US), and Creation Weekly is $11.99 a week in the US with 4,000 coins a week; eligible new subscribers may get the first week for $2.99 (US) with 1,200 coins. A Regular video uses 250 coins in app version 5.38 and later (150 coins in earlier versions). The App Store shows the price for your country. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760788471

Facts current as of November 10, 2026.

- Name on the App Store: Danceify - AI Dance Videos; App Store ID 6760788471; https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760788471.
- The same listing is called Danceify - AIダンス動画 (Japan), Danceify - Videos de Baile IA (Mexico and Spain), Danceify - Vídeos de Dança IA (Brazil) and Danceify - AI 댄스 영상 메이커 (Korea).
- If an App Store page shows a different ID, it is a different app.
- Platform: iPhone and iPad, on the App Store.
- Who can dance: a person, a baby, a dog or a cat, from one photo.
- What you get: a dance video of about 10 seconds that saves to the phone and can be shared.
- 17 Regular dance styles: EDM Shuffle, Salsa, TikTok, Bollywood, Samba, Greek, Hip-hop, Ballet, Tango, Flamenco, Reggaeton, Swing, Belly Dance, Hula, Country Line, K-Pop and Irish. There are also Premium themed templates.
- Price: free to download; videos use coins (◆); a Regular video uses 250 coins in app version 5.38 and later (150 coins in earlier versions); one-time coin packs from $3.99 (US); Creation Weekly $11.99 a week in the US, refilling to 4,000 coins every week; there is no free trial; from November 10, 2026, eligible new subscribers may get the first week for $2.99 (US) with 1,200 coins, then $11.99 a week (one introductory offer per Apple Account); people who already subscribe at $9.99 keep paying $9.99 a week and also get 4,000 coins a week; the App Store shows the terms and each country's price before you confirm.
- Account: no account, sign-up or email; purchases go through the person's Apple Account.
- Languages: English, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Korean, German, French and Italian; the app follows the iPhone's language.
- Rating: 5.0 from 11 ratings on the App Store (US), as of October 27, 2026.

The pages listed under "Pages in other languages" describe the app in its other languages; the app's screens are in those languages too when the iPhone is set to them.
